rules: Grade 8 applications for 2027 opened 12 Jan 2026 and closed 15 May 2026. Grades 9-11 open in June.
Hand-deliver the application form, code of conduct, financial clearance form and documents to the front office. Incomplete applications are not accepted.

KZN does not draw official feeder zones. Each public school's governing body writes its own admission policy under the SA Schools Act and KZN regulations, and the Head of Department now has the final say on it (BELA Act, 2024).
Many KZN schools give first preference to children for whom the school is their NEAREST public school of that phase, measured from your home gate to the school gate. There is no fixed km radius.
A public school may not refuse your child because you can't afford the fees, and you can apply for a full or partial fee exemption.
Public schools may not set admission tests.

You need proof of address, usually a municipal or utility bill or a bank statement not older than 3 months, in the parent's name. Giving a false address can get the place cancelled and is now a criminal offence.
If your child is refused, you can appeal to the KZN Department of Education. For late placement help, go to your district or circuit office.
Draft national rules (Aug 2025) propose one online system with priority: feeder zone, then siblings, then staff children, then distance. These were still drafts and disputed at last check.
